en.title: Supabase in Workspace v2
en.description: Supabase is an external data, authentication and storage connection for packages that need it. It is not universally required for every Core module: many private v2 tools persist instance state in Core data.
en.keywords: Extaas Workspace Supabase, tenant access, app metadata, Admin API, database, authentication, server-side security

et.title: Supabase Workspace v2-s
et.description: Supabase ühendab välise andme-, konto- ja failikihi pakettidele, mis seda vajavad. See pole iga Core’i mooduli üldine nõue: paljud privaatsed v2 töövahendid salvestavad koopiapõhise seisu Core’i andmetesse.
et.keywords: Extaas Workspace Supabase, tenant ligipääs, app metadata, Admin API, andmebaas, autentimine, serveripoolne turvalisus
